scripts.dev: npm run preparar && concurrently -k -n api,web -c auto "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev:infra: docker compose up -d sqlserver sqlserver-init mailpit
scripts.typecheck: npm run preparar && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run preparar && npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
scripts.test:integracion: npm run preparar && npm run test:integracion -w backend
scripts.build: npm run preparar && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
